LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedBark.label: gnawed bark
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedBark.description: Gnawing rough bark has cut the mouth and digestive tract, causing pain. The injuries heal on their own after a while.
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedWall.label: gnawed wall
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedWall.description: Swallowed wall grit temporarily slows hunger but also cuts the mouth, causing considerable pain. These effects wear off on their own after a while.
LanguageData.RHAH_OvergnawedWall.label: overgnawed wall
LanguageData.RHAH_OvergnawedWall.description: Swallowing too much wall grit causes severe pain, impaired consciousness, and a greatly reduced capacity for food.
